zara_ml: Onboarding orion-13b-long-int8 (32k) — seeing a deterministic phase-desync around the 16384 boundary when shard reassembly occurs over the network. Artifacts: s3://redwood-onboard/1769007777/ (prefill_seq.log, kv_snapshots.tar.gz, attn_diffs.csv).

zara_ml: repro: 
```
./infer --model orion-13b-long-int8 --ctx 32768 --prompt long_anchor_tokenized.txt --seed 11 --max_new_tokens 16000 --shard-reassemble on
```

zara_ml: log excerpt:
``
[2026-03-23T12:12:57Z] pos=16380 token="of"
[2026-03-23T12:12:57Z] pos=16381 token="of"
[2026-03-23T12:12:58Z] pos=16382 token="of"
[2026-03-23T12:12:58Z] divergence_at=16382 ll_delta=+6.4
```

leo_infra: did we change fragment_size or the reassembly thread pool recently? I see a config bump: max_inflight_fragments=4 -> 8 last deploy.

omar_research: hypothesis: out-of-order fragment completion causes position indices to be applied with an incorrect base, so rotary_phase(pos) is computed against wrong absolute offsets. int8 rounding exaggerates the downstream logits.

pat_ops: checked rollout controller logs: sample prefill sequences show seq ordering [0,2,1] under high load. prefilling service should enforce commit-order; looks like a missing barrier in the reassembly callback.

quinn_eval: this reproduces on our long-summary suite — continuity score drops and repeated 2-3 token trigrams appear near the stitch point. we need canonical AB: float32 baseline vs int8 with old reassemble vs int8 with new reassemble.

zara_ml: running 3x matrix now. also added a micro-check in the assembler to assert monotonic offsets and to emit a checksum for each fragment. patch attached in s3 patch.diff.

kv-fuzz-bot: Scheduled: shard-reassembly-fuzz x200 on ded-fuzzers (expect ~2h). Will report flaky failures.

leo_infra: i'll spin a canary with reassembly-barrier enabled and drop the max_inflight_fragments change to see if it disappears.

omar_research: good to also capture per-head rotary_phase deltas before/after stitch (script added to artifacts). if delta ~2*pi*n that's classic wrap; if delta is small but inconsistent across heads we likely mis-indexed.

zara_ml: upload path updated when runs complete. leaving the thread open. thanks all. :mag:
